simple.meaning: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָבַד (H6) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 185 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָבַד (ʼâbad) means properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy ) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 9 3.
